# Feature shapes (training fold only)

*Generated by `make shapes` (`credit_risk.features.shapes`) on the 215,251 training-fold applicants; do not edit by hand. Machine-readable copy: `configs/feature_shapes.csv`.*

**What it answers:** does default risk rise, fall, peak or do nothing as each feature grows? Phase 4 uses it to choose scorecard bins, Phase 5 to choose monotone constraints. Rates are per decile of the feature (fewer bins where values repeat); missing values are a separate bin in the information value (IV).

IV reading, the usual credit-scoring rule of thumb: below 0.02 none, 0.02-0.1 weak, 0.1-0.3 medium, above 0.3 strong.
